text: Ravi: quick sync 10 on the bulk-invite modal. two items: where to show SSO policy (toggle vs read-only chip) and a handy audit shortcut after a batch invite. attached mock in thread. Ana: my take 10: chip feels lighter and less scary than an inline toggle. show "SSO required" chip left of title, with tiny info icon. Maya: accessibility caveats: chip must be keyboard reachable and announced. add aria-describedby pointing to hidden explanation: 'SSO is required for this org; change in Organization settings.' Also ensure contrast >= 4.5:1. Leo: implementation: render chip as SSO required and deep-link with ?focus=sso. avoid mounting complex toggles in modal. Ana: copy tweak from compliance: use "required" not "enforced". also tooltip text: 'SSO is required for this organization. To change, go to Organization settings.' Maya: keyboard flow to test: Tab to chip, open tooltip with Enter, ensure tooltip content is in DOM and announced, then Tab to footer audit link. add skip-to-audit link at top for screen reader users. Leo: I'll prototype minimal HTML + CSS and a tiny focus script. will include Cypress keyboard test. BuildBot: queued build for feat/sso-chip at 2109991288 10 https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/3456 Ravi: perfect. quick usability with 2 admins after staging looks good. thanks all :thumbsup:
